top_stories.title: OpenAI's former Sora boss and Chief Product Officer are leaving
top_stories.summary: Bill Peebles, who led OpenAI's Sora video generation project, is departing the company alongside Chief Product Officer Kevin Weil. The exits represent a significant leadership shake-up at OpenAI's product and research divisions.

top_stories.title: Anthropic's new cybersecurity model could get it back in the government's good graces
top_stories.summary: Anthropic is developing a specialised cybersecurity AI model that could help position the company more favourably with the Trump administration. The move signals a strategic pivot toward government and defence use cases following recent tensions.

top_stories.title: Should you stare into Sam Altman's orb before your next date?
top_stories.summary: Tinder is partnering with Sam Altman's World identity verification project, which uses an iris-scanning orb to confirm users are human. The integration raises questions about biometric data use and identity verification in consumer applications.

top_stories.title: xAI rolls out Grok 4.3 beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers
top_stories.summary: xAI has released a beta version of Grok 4.3 to its SuperGrok Heavy subscribers. The update continues xAI's iterative rollout of model improvements to its premium user tier.
